BUSINESS ANALYST | SCRUM MASTER| BANKING & FINANCIAL DOMAIN | AGILE
+91 - 9884351953 | ctsaffan@gmail.com | LinkedIn |Bengaluru, India
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven with overall 14+ years of IT experience with Business Analyst experience of 8+ yrs
across complex integrated banking platforms for global financial institutions.
Strong expertise in requirements elicitation, stakeholder management, and end-to-end business
analysis, translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements.
Extensive experience in Agile / Scrum delivery, including user story creation, acceptance criteria
definition, backlog refinement, and sprint planning.
Proven domain knowledge across in-house banking platforms, Digital, Investment and commercial
banking, Everyday Business Banking, and payments lifecycle (ISO20022 and payment
transformation initiatives).
Experienced in working with external vendors and cross-functional teams to align business
requirements, perform gap analysis, and support solution delivery.
Strong analytical mindset with hands-on experience in financial calculations, and data analysis.
Proficient with JIRA, Confluence, SQL, Excel, Postman, and process-modelling tools.
Effective communication between business stakeholders and development teams to ensure a shared
understanding of project requirements.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to review story requirements and validate system
functionality
Create flow
diagrams and document technical solutions
Continuously learn and adapt to modern technologies, industry best practices, and emerging trends in
business analysis and Agile methodologies.
